A.speaker: Scene
A.line: The customer waits near the pickup hatch. Their hot meal is still in the delayed kitchen.
A.caption: Order 048 remains confirmed. You turn back to the counter.

B.speaker: Scene
B.line: The customer steps aside to think. You save their unpaid quotation without sending an order.
B.caption: Quotation Q-048 is saved. Back at work: 12:53 PM. No kitchen order.

C.speaker: Scene
C.line: The customer leaves with the wrap. That transaction is complete. You return to the next person.
C.caption: A different lunch, collected. The shift carries on.

encounter.speaker: Kitchen
encounter.caption: Kitchen hum. A distant conversation. Footsteps approach.

question.speaker: Customer
question.line: Hi. I've only got about ten minutes. Is that going to be enough?
question.caption: Another customer joins the queue.

choices.text: The estimate is eight minutes. Shall I put that through?

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: Yes, please. The hot chicken meal.
beats.caption: The printer feeds a receipt. The hot meal is sent to the kitchen.

beats.speaker: Kitchen
beats.line: Grill's backed up. Thirteen minutes on hot orders.
beats.caption: A minute passes. Order 47 is collected. The grill estimate changes to thirteen minutes.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: That may be too long. I might have to leave before it's ready.
beats.caption: A glance toward the clock. The confirmed hot order remains in the kitchen.

choices.text: You mentioned ten minutes. Is that when you need to leave?

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: I need to be back at work at 12:53. That's when my break ends.
beats.caption: They lean closer. Back at work: 12:53 PM. The order remains pending.

beats.speaker: Kitchen
beats.line: Grill's backed up. Thirteen minutes on hot orders.
beats.caption: A minute passes. Order 47 is collected. The grill estimate changes to thirteen minutes.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: That's longer than my break. Let me think for a moment.
beats.caption: The return-to-work time stays on the terminal. No order has been sent.

choices.text: There's a wrap ready now, if you'd prefer that instead.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: A wrap, then. Not what I had in mind, but I’ll take it.
beats.caption: Their gaze settles on the ready case. A chicken wrap is selected.

beats.speaker: Kitchen
beats.line: Grill's backed up. Thirteen minutes on hot orders.
beats.caption: A minute passes. Order 47 is collected. The grill estimate changes to thirteen minutes.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: I'll take it with me. A napkin as well, please.
beats.caption: Paper rustles across the counter. The wrap is handed over; the grill is still delayed.

A.speaker: Scene
A.line: The paid order remains open. Your colleague speaks to the queue while the customer waits for a reply.
A.caption: Order 049 · €25.00 paid · unreleased · register occupied.

B.speaker: Scene
B.line: The refund stays complete. The customer waits with the original details saved and no active order.
B.caption: Order 049 · €25.00 refunded · no kitchen ticket · register available.

C.speaker: Scene
C.line: Ticket 049 stays on HOLD. The kitchen has not started; the customer is still waiting for a reply.
C.caption: Three-meal ticket sent despite the request · €25.00 paid · no preparation.

encounter.speaker: Scene
encounter.line: Three meals entered. Payment accepted. The order is still on this register; nothing has reached the kitchen.
encounter.caption: Order 049 · two hot chicken meals, one vegetable meal · paid 25.00 · not sent.

encounter.speaker: Customer
encounter.line: Sorry, could you wait? My colleague might want to change the third meal. Please don't send it to the kitchen yet.
encounter.caption: They glance down at a message. The third meal is still unconfirmed.

encounter.speaker: Colleague
encounter.line: I've got more people waiting. That order's still tying up this till.
encounter.caption: A colleague looks along the queue. This is the active register.

encounter.speaker: Manager
encounter.line: Can we keep the line moving, please? There's a queue to the door.
encounter.caption: The manager calls from farther down the counter. The kitchen is still delayed.
encounter.operationalNote: An open paid order occupies this register. A refund frees it, but the customer must start again. Sending a HOLD ticket keeps its kitchen place, but sends the order; preparation waits.

question.speaker: Customer
question.line: I'm still waiting for a reply. Please leave it unsent.
question.caption: Their phone stays in hand. The paid order remains unreleased.
question.operationalNote: Open: register occupied. Refund: restart required. HOLD: ticket sent, no preparation.

choices.text: I'll keep the paid order open while you check. This register will stay occupied.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: They're checking now. I'll keep the third meal as it is until they reply.
beats.caption: Payment retained. Order 049 stays on the register, unreleased.

beats.speaker: Kitchen
beats.line: Order forty-six. Ready for collection.
beats.caption: A minute passes. Another person joins the queue. The grill estimate remains thirteen minutes.

beats.speaker: Colleague
beats.line: I'll speak to the people waiting. Your register's still tied up.
beats.caption: The colleague attends to the growing queue. The customer keeps checking; the paid order is not sent.

choices.text: I'll refund it and free the register. We can start a new order when you're ready.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: All right. I'll have to go through the three meals again when they're ready.
beats.caption: Refund completed: 25.00. The original details are retained in history, without a kitchen order.

beats.speaker: Kitchen
beats.line: Order forty-six. Ready for collection.
beats.caption: A minute passes. Another person joins the queue. The grill estimate remains thirteen minutes.

beats.speaker: Colleague
beats.line: The refund's complete. I'll take the next person while they check.
beats.caption: The register is available. The next customer advances; a new order will be needed.

choices.text: I'll send a HOLD ticket to keep its place. The kitchen will wait to prepare it.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: I asked you not to send it. Is the kitchen already making it?
beats.caption: Ticket 049 sent despite the request. HOLD ALL ITEMS: do not prepare. The register is available.

beats.speaker: Kitchen
beats.line: Order forty-six. Ready for collection.
beats.caption: A minute passes. Another person joins the queue. The grill estimate remains thirteen minutes.

beats.speaker: Colleague
beats.line: All three meals are on hold. The ticket exists, but preparation hasn't started.
beats.caption: The kitchen holds all three meals, including the third. The earlier request remains recorded. The next customer advances.

encounter.speaker: Scene
encounter.line: Two minutes later. Their phone vibrates. A reply has arrived.
encounter.caption: 12:49 PM. A short phone vibration. The grill is still delayed; the queue remains.

encounter.speaker: Customer
encounter.line: I've heard back. We only need the two chicken meals now. Could you remove the third one?
encounter.caption: The message changes the request: two chicken meals, €17.20. Remove the €7.80 vegetable meal.

encounter.speaker: Customer
encounter.line: You've kept it open all this time?
encounter.caption: They look toward the waiting line. €25.00 remains paid; order 049 is still on this register, with no ticket.
encounter.operationalNote: Review the original transaction, new request and remaining authorization.

B.line: Oh, you've refunded it? I thought we were waiting.
B.caption: A refund notification is on their phone. €25.00 was returned. No active order or kitchen ticket exists.

C.line: You sent something through? I asked you to wait.
C.caption: Ticket 049 still holds three meals. €25.00 is paid; preparation has not started. The earlier request remains recorded.

question.speaker: Customer
question.line: Where are we with the order?
question.caption: The revised request waits. The original payment and ticket records remain.

choices.text: Let me explain exactly where the order stands. Then we'll confirm the change before I do anything else.

beats.speaker: You
beats.line: I kept all three meals open, as you asked. Your twenty-five euros is still paid. Nothing has gone to the kitchen, and this register has stayed occupied. We can remove the vegetable meal, return seven eighty, and send the two chicken meals if you confirm.
beats.caption: You explain the occupied register and unreleased order. No correction has been made yet.

B.line: I refunded the twenty-five euros to free the register. There is no active order or kitchen ticket. For two chicken meals, we need a new order and a fresh payment of seventeen twenty. May I take that payment and send the new order?
B.caption: The original refund remains complete. No new payment is assumed.

C.line: I sent ticket forty-nine on hold, even though you asked me not to send it. All three meals are on it, but preparation hasn't started. Your twenty-five euros is still paid. With your confirmation, I can amend that ticket, return seven eighty, and release the two meals.
C.caption: You name the earlier action. Ticket history remains; no amendment or release has happened yet.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: Yes. Remove the vegetable meal, return the seven eighty, and send the two chicken meals.
beats.caption: The customer explicitly confirms the change, adjustment and release.

B.line: Yes. Start the new order. I authorize a new payment of seventeen twenty, and you can send the two chicken meals.
B.caption: Fresh payment and release are explicitly authorized. The prior refund is not reversed.

C.line: Yes. Amend that ticket to two chicken meals, return the seven eighty, and release the hold.

beats.speaker: Colleague
beats.line: The seven eighty is returned. Order forty-nine is now two chicken meals, released to the kitchen. Preparation hasn't started.
beats.caption: €7.80 adjustment recorded. Corrected order released after confirmation; no meals are prepared or collected.

B.line: New order fifty: seventeen twenty paid with your authorization, then sent. The earlier twenty-five-euro refund stays on record. Preparation hasn't started.
B.caption: Order 050 is paid and released. Refunded order 049 stays in history. Nothing is prepared or collected.

C.line: Ticket forty-nine is amended to two chicken meals and released. Seven eighty is returned. The original hold remains in its history. Preparation hasn't started.
C.caption: The same ticket has an amendment and a release record. No duplicate ticket or preparation.

choices.text: I'll update it for two meals now. I'll let you know what I need from you.

beats.speaker: You
beats.line: I've removed the vegetable meal and returned seven eighty. Shall I send the two chicken meals now?
beats.caption: Two meals remain. The €7.80 adjustment is complete; order 049 is still unreleased pending permission.

B.line: A new order for two chicken meals comes to seventeen twenty. The earlier twenty-five euros has been refunded. I'll need a fresh payment before I send it.
B.caption: Draft 050 is entered for €17.20, unpaid and unsent. No payment has been authorized or charged.

C.line: I've amended ticket forty-nine to two chicken meals and returned seven eighty. It's still on hold. May I release it?
C.caption: Ticket 049 now has an explicit amendment. €7.80 returned. HOLD stays until release is authorized.

beats.speaker: Customer
beats.line: Yes, send the two chicken meals.
beats.caption: The customer authorizes release after the change.

B.line: Let me get my card. That refund is still showing on my phone.
B.caption: Getting a card is not payment authorization. Draft 050 stays unpaid and unsent.

C.line: Yes. You can release the two chicken meals now.

beats.speaker: Colleague
beats.line: Order forty-nine is released for two chicken meals. The adjustment is recorded. Preparation hasn't started.
beats.caption: The corrected paid order is released after permission. The queue moves; the kitchen remains delayed.

B.line: The new order is entered. Payment is pending; nothing has gone to the kitchen. I'll keep the line moving while you get your card.
B.caption: Draft 050 · €17.20 · awaiting fresh authorization. Order 049 remains refunded. Correction is not complete.

C.line: The amended ticket is released. Its original three-meal hold is still on record. Preparation hasn't started.
C.caption: Ticket 049 retains its original send, amendment and authorized release. No new ticket or preparation.

choices.text: I'll bring my colleague into this with the full details, so you don't have to explain everything again.

beats.speaker: You
beats.line: They asked us to leave three meals unsent. I kept the paid order open: twenty-five euros, no kitchen ticket, register occupied. Now they only need two chicken meals. Please confirm the change, return seven eighty, and get permission to send it.
beats.caption: You give your colleague the original request, action, payment, ticket state, new request and remaining work.

B.line: They asked us to leave three meals unsent. I refunded the twenty-five euros to free the register. There is no active order or kitchen ticket. Now they need two chicken meals. Please confirm a new order, fresh payment of seventeen twenty, and permission to send it.

C.line: They asked us not to send three meals. I sent ticket forty-nine on hold despite that request. Twenty-five euros is paid; preparation hasn't started. Now they need two chicken meals. Please confirm the amendment, return seven eighty, and get permission to release the ticket.

beats.speaker: Colleague
beats.line: I've got the paid, unsent order and the new request. I'll take responsibility here and confirm the adjustment and release with you before I continue.
beats.caption: The colleague accepts the work. This register is released for the queue; the order itself remains uncorrected.

B.line: I've got the refunded order details and the new request. I'll confirm a fresh order and payment with you. Nothing will be charged or sent before that.
B.caption: The colleague accepts the complete history. No active order, new payment or ticket yet.

C.line: I've got ticket forty-nine on hold and the new request. I'll confirm the amendment, refund and release with you. The hold stays until then.
C.caption: The colleague accepts the held ticket and its history. Three meals remain on HOLD; the amendment is still pending.

beats.speaker: Scene
beats.line: Your colleague stays with the customer. You turn to the waiting line. The correction is still theirs to finish.
beats.caption: Responsibility transferred, work unfinished. The original transaction and revised request stay together.
